svg.title: Dirty price and clean price of a 10-year bond
svg.desc: A 10-year bond with a 3% coupon paid every six months and a constant yield of 5%. The dirty price rises between two coupon dates and falls by the coupon of 1.5 on each coupon date, so it draws a saw-tooth. The clean price is the dirty price minus the accrued interest. It rises smoothly from 84.4 at the issue to the par value of 100 at maturity.
svg.text: 10-year bond, 3% coupon (paid every six months), constant yield of 5%
Dirty price (the price that the buyer pays)
Accrued interest = dirty price − clean price
On each coupon date, the dirty price
